How the chart works

What counts
A pick: a CHO searches Apple Music in the Now Batting song editor and chooses a song for a player. Songs added through the parent link, a roster import or a shared roster aren’t counted.
The window
Each Monday’s chart covers the 28 days ending Sunday at midnight, Eastern time. One week of picks is too thin to rank honestly, so every week looks back four.
How it ranks
By how many different CHOs picked a song. Picking it for five players still counts once, so one very busy team can’t carry a song. Ties go to total picks, then to the most recent week. A song needs at least 3 CHOs to chart.
Versions
A single, an album cut and a clean edit of the same song count together, and the row links to the version CHOs picked most. Explicit versions aren’t counted or shown.
When it updates
Every Monday morning. “Last week” and weeks on the chart compare against the previous Monday’s chart; a song’s first appearance is marked NEW, a return is RE-ENTRY.
Privacy
We publish rankings only. No counts, no player or team names, nothing about who picked what.
